items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section I, List of Answers on Terminology 38:1
items.html: If the disparity of form of a degree from the root is not so evident as to separate it from the root, it is discerned as “touching” the root. The same applies between one degree and another. (Part 1, Chapter 2, Inner Light, Item 5)
